name: trading-ai-platform
description: Full-Stack Algorithmic Trading Platform — AI Engine, Core Backend, Client App

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,ai-engine,client -c yellow,magenta,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai-engine" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n backend,tsc -c yellow,blue "cd core-backend && npm run dev" "cd core-backend && npx tsc --noEmit --watch"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently -n client,lint -c green,yellow "cd client-app && npm run dev" "cd client-app && npx next lint --quiet 2>nul"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd core-backend && npm install && cd ../client-app && npm install && cd ../ai-engine && if (-not (Test-Path venv)) { python -m venv venv } && .\venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: cd core-backend && npm run build && cd ../client-app && npm run build
